requireCommandOrControlEnterToSend.desc: When enabled, Enter inserts a newline. Command+Enter sends on macOS; Ctrl+Enter sends on Windows and Linux.

loadUserSettings.desc: Load user-level Claude Code configuration from ~/.claude: settings.json, skills, commands, agents, and plugins. When disabled, only vault-level configuration is available. When enabled, user permission rules may bypass Safe mode.

codexSandbox.name: Sandbox
codexSandbox.desc: File access in Approve for me and Ask for approval modes. Read only asks before every edit; Full access ignores this.

sharedEnvironment.name: Shared environment
sharedEnvironment.desc: Provider-neutral runtime variables shared across all providers. Use this for PATH, proxy, cert, and temp variables.

customVariables.name: Custom variables
customVariables.desc: Runtime variables owned by Claude Code only. Use this for ANTHROPIC_* and Claude Code-specific toggles.

enableChrome.name: Enable Chrome extension
enableChrome.desc: Allow Claude Code to interact with Chrome via the claude-in-chrome extension. Requires the extension to be installed. Requires session restart.

enableDualPane.name: Enable dual-pane mode
enableDualPane.desc: Automatically show the session manager beside the chat when the view is at least 600 px wide.

restoreTabsOnStartup.name: Restore tabs on startup
restoreTabsOnStartup.desc: Reopen all tabs in single-pane mode or the last active tab in dual-pane mode.

sessionAutoArchiveAfter.name: Auto-archive inactive sessions
sessionAutoArchiveAfter.desc: Archive unpinned sessions with no activity for the chosen period. Open and running sessions are skipped.
sessionAutoArchiveAfter.multiSelectHint: Option-click (Alt-click on Windows and Linux) sessions to select several, then right-click to pin or archive them.

dualPaneSide.name: Dual-pane side
dualPaneSide.desc: Choose which side of the chat the session manager appears on.

enableAutoScroll.name: Auto-scroll during streaming
enableAutoScroll.desc: Automatically scroll to the bottom as Claude streams responses. Disable to stay at the top and read from the beginning.

showMessageTimestamps.name: Show message timestamps
showMessageTimestamps.desc: Display each message's local send or arrival time in the chat thread.

deferMathRenderingDuringStreaming.name: Defer math rendering during streaming
deferMathRenderingDuringStreaming.desc: Show raw LaTeX while responses stream, then render math once when each text block completes.

pluginRenderedFenceLanguages.name: Fence languages rendered by plugins
pluginRenderedFenceLanguages.desc: Code block languages, one per line, passed to the plugin that renders them in notes (for example vega-lite). They render once the response finishes. Other code blocks always display as code.

expandFileEditsByDefault.name: Expand file edits by default
expandFileEditsByDefault.desc: Show Write and Edit diffs expanded when they first appear.

chatViewPlacement.name: Open Claudian in
chatViewPlacement.desc: Choose where the chat panel opens when it is created

enableZenMode.name: Enable zen mode
enableZenMode.desc: Keep a minimal chat interface visible when the sidebar is hidden.

responseStyle.desc: Claude Code output style for replies, including custom styles. “Claude Code setting” follows your Claude Code configuration. The list updates when models are refreshed or a chat starts.

wslDistroOverride.desc: Optional advanced override. Leave empty to infer the distro from a WSL workspace path when possible, otherwise use the default WSL distro.

responseStyle.name: Response style

responseVerbosity.desc: Choose the amount of detail in responses on supported models. Default uses your Codex configuration.

reasoningSummary.desc: Show a summary of the model's reasoning process in the thinking block.

ultraEffort.name: Enable ultra effort
ultraEffort.desc: Allow Ultra in the effort selector for Codex models that advertise support. Ultra uses maximum reasoning with automatic task delegation.

models.desc: Claudian keeps its own model list, separate from Pi's enabledModels. Discover lists every model Pi can authenticate in its current environment, grouped by the provider route Pi will call. The route determines credentials and billing.

environment.name: Grok Build environment variables
environment.desc: Environment variables passed only to Grok Build. Custom-model secrets stay in this provider scope and are referenced from native config by env_key.

installation.desc: Auto prefers dsh, then discovers Desktop on macOS or Windows. To use Desktop when both are installed, enter its .app path or Windows install folder. Open Desktop once to complete setup.

codeMode.name: Enable code mode
codeMode.desc: Applies from each conversation's next turn, including existing conversations. Adds native run_code alongside direct tools.

presetPlugins.name: Additional preset plugins
presetPlugins.desc: Advanced. A YAML list (dsh's format) of native dsh plugin rows appended to Claudian's chat preset, each with its own "id" and "name". Rows cannot replace Claudian's own. Saving restarts DeepSeek Harness, which stops running turns. Plugins Claudian has no interface for, such as plan mode, may not work.

environment.name: DeepSeek Harness environment variables
environment.desc: Environment variables passed only to DeepSeek Harness. Uses your selected native Web or Desktop profile, credentials, models and MCP servers.
